test: Analyze a non-demo dataset. All six panels must use only that result, with no seeded mock fallback.

before.remarks: Code audit: four panels still generate demo series or items.

after.remarks: Exact dataset lookup; no mock generators. All-panel render checks pass.

test: Switch forecast metrics. Dates, values and bands must match the backend metric selected.

before.remarks: Code audit: random fixed 2025 series ignores backend forecast.

after.remarks: Metric-specific history/forecast and numeric-value render tests pass.

test: Analyze posts with unavailable views/saves/sales. Show unavailable rather than a fabricated forecast.

before.remarks: Code audit: missing metrics still display a seeded forecast.

after.remarks: Known-input test: unavailable views have no history or forecast.

test: Report forecast accuracy only from held-out observations. Explain its basis and insufficient history.

before.remarks: Analytics audit: fitted residuals labeled accuracy, clipped to 40–97%.

after.remarks: Holdout train/test dates and separate forecasts verified.

test: Forecast reminder control must perform a real supported action and not falsely claim scheduling.

before.remarks: Code audit: button only toggles local text to Reminder set.

after.remarks: Replaced false reminder with a real forecast CSV download link.

test: Open Similar trends. Show actual matching historical windows, dates, post titles and source links.

before.remarks: Code audit: count has no clickable evidence or matching windows.

after.remarks: Historical window dates, actual post IDs and links verified.

test: Explain the trend, current metric, historical scope and missing evidence without claiming global research.

before.remarks: Documentation claims social media as a whole without that data.

after.remarks: Profile-only scope and unsupported-duration empty state verified.

test: Select a collected post or paste its URL. Find compares it to other collected posts using linked titles.

before.remarks: Code audit: Item A/B placeholders and no post selector.

after.remarks: Real titles, linked sources and collected-URL selector tests pass.

test: Similarity reflects caption, comment text and observed metric patterns. Changing the selected post updates ranking.

before.remarks: Code audit: rankings are seeded percentages, not comparisons.

after.remarks: Known caption/comment patterns rank the correct matching posts.

test: Generate strategy with Gemma using statistics and online references. Identify sources and any fallback.

before.remarks: Code audit: hard-coded plays and invented reach lift percentages.

after.remarks: Pipeline/citations pass mocked tests. Live reference fetch passes. See LLM-02.

test: Analyze eight posts whose captions are only stop words. Analysis must not crash.

before.remarks: Reproduced: ValueError empty vocabulary in TF-IDF.

after.remarks: Five empty-vocabulary variants complete without a crash.

test: Trend line includes actual numeric values, period labels and the selected metric.

before.remarks: Code audit: line has no numeric axis or values.

after.remarks: Actual values, numeric axis, dates and accessible value table verified.

test: Bar values must equal metric totals for each displayed period, with readable labels.

before.remarks: Code audit: values scaled to rounded axis maximum, altering totals.

after.remarks: Known-input totals reconcile exactly across periods and posts.

test: Post comparison bars show post titles on hover/focus and source links, with a post dropdown.

before.remarks: Code audit: no per-post comparison or post selector.

after.remarks: Post dropdown, title tooltips and source links render correctly.

test: Pie comparison includes every post and correct metric shares, including more than three groups.

before.remarks: Code audit: first three types only; post comparison absent.

after.remarks: All five fixture posts appear; metric shares sum to 100%.

test: Use oppositely ranked likes/comments. Both pair and matrix must report Spearman −1, not +1.

before.remarks: Reproduced: pair returns +1 because abs() removes the sign.

after.remarks: Known opposite ranks now return -1 in both pair and matrix.

test: Matrix and scatter use collected values and available metric names, with no Recommended pseudo-metric.

before.remarks: Code audit: matrix and scatter are random demo values.

after.remarks: Matrix and scatter use the same observed values and metric names.

test: Negative only and Strong only filters update the relationship list as well as the matrix.

before.remarks: Code audit: filters apply only to matrix cells.

after.remarks: Negative/strong filters update the tested pair list and matrix.

test: Exclude unavailable/constant metrics; explain insufficient pairs instead of drawing synthetic points.

before.remarks: Code audit: UI always draws six metrics and synthetic scatter.

after.remarks: Missing/constant metrics excluded. Empty render state verified.

test: Render collected keywords and comments that contain no demo keyword. Empty results remain readable.

before.remarks: Panel regression tests pass for real keywords and empty data.

after.remarks: Real-keyword and empty-data render regression tests still pass.

test: Each comment has a safe source. Parent-post fallback is explicitly labeled when no direct URL exists.

before.remarks: Evidence and rendered source-link tests pass.

after.remarks: Safe direct/parent source-link regression tests still pass.

test: When no comments were returned, clearly label caption sentiment rather than audience sentiment.

before.remarks: Backend caption-basis regression test passes.

after.remarks: Caption-only basis remains explicit in data and rendered text.

test: Weekly/monthly demand bars show complete dates and numeric counts below/above the corresponding bars.

before.remarks: Render audit: full dates and count labels already present.

after.remarks: Full date and count labels retained in rendered demand charts.

test: Count questions and requests from sampled comments even without sales/views. Distinct-comment rate must not double count.

before.remarks: Backend known-input inquiry and request tests pass.

after.remarks: Known question/request counts and distinct-comment rate pass.

test: Import a CSV without views/sales/saves. Track absent columns as unavailable; do not estimate views.

before.remarks: Code audit: absent columns become zero and views may be invented.

after.remarks: Absent CSV metric columns marked unavailable; no estimated views.

test: Import post URLs and reject negative metrics. Preserve links in evidence and comparisons.

before.remarks: Code audit: upload drops URLs and permits negative counts.

after.remarks: CSV URL preservation and negative-count rejection tests pass.

test: Reject malformed/unsupported profiles; keep collector cancellation, login and request timeouts functional.

before.remarks: Existing API and collector regression suites pass.

after.remarks: Existing validation, timeout, login and cancellation tests pass.

test: Storage failure must not break health/history or core analysis. Return an explicit availability state.

before.remarks: Live /api/history returned HTTP 500 on baseline.

after.remarks: Storage failure test returns 200 with explicit unavailable state.

test: Send complete bounded JSON containing demand, sentiment and post/comment evidence; accept only supplied citation URLs.

before.remarks: Payload and source-validation regression tests pass.

after.remarks: Whole JSON, evidence coverage and allowlisted citation tests pass.

test: Obtain a real response from configured Google Gemma service and verify strategy citations.

before.remarks: Google returned HTTP 500 in live check; fallback is not a model pass.

after.remarks: Live Google returned quota/rate-limit error. No real model success claimed.

test: Navigate six panels and verify neomorphic controls, readable labels and no blank sentiment panel in Chrome.

before.remarks: Initial browser check blocked by private active tab; visual retest pending.

after.remarks: Markup tests pass; native browser connection lost. Interactive QA unverified.

test: Keep API keys and browser cookies out of Git and client build; reject unsafe evidence URLs.

before.remarks: Ignored secrets/session paths and source URL regression checks pass.

after.remarks: Secret/session ignores retained; unsafe source URLs rejected.

test: The Vite server must refuse HTTP access to collector browser storage. Exclude that folder from frontend file watching.

before.remarks: Harmless marker in collector storage was served with HTTP 200.

after.remarks: Same marker probe returns HTTP 403 after deny rules; watcher excludes backend.
